items.source: Set the value of the data field. If the data argument is a multi-line String, it will be turned into multiple data field lines as defined in the Server-Sent Events W3C recommendation. If data is not a String, it will be encoded into JSON.
items.translation: 设置 `data` 字段的值。如果 `data` 参数是一个多行 `String`，它将按照服务器发送事件（Server-Sent Events）W3C 推荐规范转换为多个 `data` 字段行。如果 `data` 不是字符串，它将被 编码 为 JSON。

items.source: Set the value of the event field.
Set the value of the id field.
Set the value of the retry field.

Set SSE comment. If a multi-line comment is provided, it will be turned into multiple
SSE comment lines as defined in Server-Sent Events W3C recommendation.
items.translation: 设置 SSE 注释。如果提供了多行注释，它将按照服务器发送事件 (Server-Sent Events) W3C 推荐规范转换为多个 SSE 注释行。

items.source: T - the type of data that this event contains
items.translation: T - 此事件包含的数据类型

items.source: id - the value of the id field
event - the value of the event field
